title: Fees & Payment
lead: Termly fees by level, for day and boarding students, and how to pay them safely.

warning.heading: Pay only into the school's official account.
warning.text: The school will never ask you to pay into a personal account. If in doubt, call the Bursary first.

termly.caption: Fees per term, 2027/2028 [SAMPLE]
termly.note: Three terms per session. Amounts are per term. [SAMPLE]

instalments: Termly fees can be paid in two instalments, the second before mid-term. Ask the Bursary to set this up. [SAMPLE]
sibling: 10% off tuition from the second child enrolled at the same time. [SAMPLE]

online.text: Card or bank transfer through the school's secure payment page. A receipt is sent by SMS and email. [SAMPLE]

account.note: Use the student's name and class as the payment reference.
